title: Personal Services Catalogue by Package
content:
The Personal Services Plan offers two kinds of service. Hourly services are delivered against personal service hours; a la carte services are priced separately and are never drawn from hours. The catalogue is the same on every tier, but three services can be booked only under the packages that make them available.

## Hourly services (all tiers)

Extra housekeeping; laundry and linen; companion visits; escorts on campus; escorts off campus; errands and shopping; pet care.

## A la carte services (all tiers)

Private transportation; handyman work; an overnight companion; grocery delivery.

## Services that depend on the package

| Tier | Pet walking and pet care | Escort to off-campus appointments | Overnight companion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | Not available | Not available | Not available |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | Not available | Not available | Not available |
| Personal Services Companion Package | Not available | Available | Not available |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | Available | Available | Not available |
| Personal Services Premier Package | Available | Available | Available |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | Available | Available | Available |

## Points of reading

- Pet care is listed among the hourly services on every tier, yet it can be booked only on the Comfort, Premier and Concierge Packages.
- An off-campus escort can be booked from the Companion Package upward.
- An overnight companion is an a la carte service on every tier's list, yet it can be booked only on the Premier and Concierge Packages.
